correctness.rationale: For 8-point E in F2^4, t absent from E+E iff E+t=E^c. If E is nonhyperplane, |T(E)|<=2, so its difference set has at least 13 nonzero elements. Balanced sign s=2 1_A-1 is a Walsh polynomial with at least four nonzero Fourier modes unless A is affine hyperplane; hence A has at most 11 nonzero Fourier zeros. Orthogonality forces every nonhyperplane spectrum B to be an affine hyperplane, precisely when its annihilator t complements A. Hyperplane supports yield 2^8 transversals. Exact incidence counts 15*2^8=3840 and 15*14*2^4=3360 imply profile 10080,1920,840,30 and total 14880. Independently enumerated all 12,870 eight-sets and all t using Python integer bit masks; T histogram {0:10080,1:1920,2:840,8:30}. This separate finite check corroborates but does not replace the structural proof.
